rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties, and each unit-month of use may be a separate violation.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each unit/month may be a separate violation
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential dwelling units in San Francisco using qualifying algorithmic devices.
rules.penalty: Damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation (S.F. Admin. Code § 37.10C(b) and (d))
rules.quoted_span: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; effective date given only as month (October 2024).

rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use prohibited algorithmic rent-setting devices, similar to San Francisco's ordinance. Tenants may sue for damages, injunctive relief, and penalties, with each month and affected property potentially a separate violation.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month and property may be a separate violation
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential rental property in San Diego using algorithmic rent-setting devices.
rules.penalty: Damages, injunctive relief and penalties up to $1,000 per violation (San Diego Mun. Code §§ 98.1103(b) & 98.1104(a))
rules.quoted_span: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; effective date given only as month (June 2025).

rules.title: Berkeley ban on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use coordinated rent-pricing algorithms. Violations accrue per unit per month, and tenants have private remedies.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential rental units in Berkeley.
rules.penalty: Recurring unit/month violations and private remedies
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies, previously at issue in RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley et al. , (N.D. Cal.) (voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026).
rules.conflict_note: Secondary source. RealPage's challenge (RealPage, Inc. v. City of Berkeley) was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice Jan. 14, 2026. Effective date given only as month.

rules.title: Santa Ana ban on anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing tools. Tenants may bring private claims for up to $1,000 per violation per month.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation and per month
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential rental units in Santa Ana.
rules.penalty: Private tenant claims; up to $1,000 per violation and per month
rules.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; municipal code section not given.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ban is enforced publicly and privately, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential rental units in Jersey City.
rules.penalty: Public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; effective date given only as month (June 2025).

rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of residential rental units in Hoboken.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary law-firm source; the citation format (ch. 158-2) may not match the official codification. Effective date given only as month.
